name: Shadows of Ambition
source:
Welcome to Shadows of Ambition! It's an adult Kinetic Novel that will explore the relationship between Luke and Alice. 

Join Luke in his journey to Nyctora City where he meets his girlfriend Alice and a whole cast of different characters. Luke will get entangled in a whole bunch of different hot scenarios which will test his resolve. Will he stay the pure hearted soul that he is, or will he surrender himself to corruption?

[From [url=https://shadowsofambition.itch.io/shadows-of-ambition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到野心之影！这是一部成人动感小说，将探讨卢克和爱丽丝之间的关系。

加入卢克前往尼克托拉市的旅程，在那里他遇到了他的女朋友爱丽丝和一群不同的角色。卢克将陷入一大堆不同的热门场景中，这将考验他的决心。他会保持纯洁的灵魂，还是会屈服于腐败？

[来自[url=https://shadowsofambition.itch.io/shadows-of-ambition]itch.io[/url]]
